tasks.title: HANGS Construction Services · 2026 Estimated Tax
tasks.description: Plan the 2026 federal estimated tax of HANGS Construction Services LLC from 6 Excel, PDF, Word and email documents. Test the large-corporation rule, build the Publication 542 worksheet that replaced Form 1120-W, set the prior-year safe harbor against the projected tax, work the annualized income installment method as Form 2220 Schedule A does, apply the payments made so far and preview the underpayment penalty. Produce formula-linked Excel workpapers and a draft plan with the remaining payments and an EFTPS schedule. Open items stay open for a person. This demo plays back one recorded run; the run’s real working time is shown at the end.
tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with evidence tabs, and a draft estimated tax plan PDF with evidence trails and original source attachments
tasks.gates: Draft plan, not reviewed. Nothing has been paid or scheduled. A person reviews and schedules the payments.
tasks.periodLine: Tax year 2026 (calendar) · Form 1120 estimated tax: four installments, April 15 to December 15 · next due December 15, 2026.
